newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African stocks end weak on futures-related trade.
newsitem.headline: S.African stocks end weak on futures-related trade.

text.p: Heavy futures-related trade pushed South African shares to close, fuelled by concerns on a struggling rand which tested another all-time low on the dollar. Gold shares weakened on poor sentiment about the rand.
Dealers said futures players were dominant, responsible for over 50 percent of the trade.
They said foreigners were absent in the market since the currency devaluation eroded whatever profits they made on equities.
Talk that the rand would reach five rand to the dollar by end of this year was chasing away foreigners, they said.
The overall index fell 96.3 points to 6,868 points and the industrial index dropped 106.8 points to 8,114.4 points and gold index slipped 11.7 points to end at 1,706 points.
